name: Migration planner with grandfathering keeps MRR unchanged
description: Verify enabling grandfathering removes affected customers and keeps the MRR change at zero.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, then click the 'Migration' link in the top navigation bar
Assert 'Customers affected' shows 0, 'MRR before' and 'MRR after' both show $145.00, and 'MRR change' shows +$0.00
